description: This file defines the MAX_Dal_Admin_Banners class, which manages database operations related to banners in the Revive Adserver project, including retrieving, counting, and moving banners, as well as joining banners with campaigns and clients.

classes.name: MAX_Dal_Admin_Banners
classes.description: A data access layer class for managing banner records, including retrieval, counting, and updating banner data within the Revive Adserver system.

methods.name: getBannerByKeyword
methods.description: Retrieves banners matching a keyword, optionally filtered by agency ID.

methods.name: getAllBanners
methods.description: Retrieves all banners ordered by specified field and direction.

methods.name: getAllBannersUnderAgency
methods.description: Retrieves banners associated with a specific agency, ordered by specified field and direction.

methods.name: getAllBannersUnderCampaign
methods.description: Retrieves banners under a specific campaign.

methods.name: countActiveBanners
methods.description: Counts the number of active banners.

methods.name: countActiveBannersUnderAdvertiser
methods.description: Counts active banners under a specific advertiser.

methods.name: countActiveBannersUnderAgency
methods.description: Counts active banners under a specific agency.

methods.name: _rekeyBannersArray
methods.description: Reformats a flat array of banners into an associative array keyed by banner ID.

methods.name: moveBannerToCampaign
methods.description: Moves a banner to a different campaign.

methods.name: getBannersCampaignsClients
methods.description: Joins banners with campaigns and clients, returning the combined data as a RecordSet.
